entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return an item. It's the pair of spin class shoes I ordered.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I guess it's a preference, but they just hurt so much. I've tried them in three classes, and they've given me terrible blisters on my heels. I also feel like the cleats never sit right, no matter how I adjust them. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort; that’s definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up your order and check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-554-8912. I was just really hoping to get a refund. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and with the holidays just passing, I really needed this money back. I feel bad even asking.

I understand completely. Thank you for that order number. Let me see... Okay, I see the order was delivered 16 days ago. Looking here at our policy, standard items are eligible for return within 90 days.
So you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much.

Of course! I'm happy to help. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to you. Simply package the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and drop them at a post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive them.
That is wonderful news. You've really helped me out today, Alex. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
